title: Contents Coverage Minimums for Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Classes
content:
Each unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement sets a minimum amount of contents coverage the tenant must carry, and states whether proof of the tenant's own homeowner's or renter's policy may satisfy the requirement.

| Unit class | Minimum contents coverage | Own homeowner's or renter's policy accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $2000 | yes |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $2000 | yes |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $2000 | yes |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $3000 | yes |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $5000 | yes |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $10000 | yes |

## Definitions

- **Minimum contents coverage** — the least contents coverage, in US dollars, the tenant must carry for this unit class.
- **Own policy accepted** — whether proof of the tenant's own homeowner's or renter's policy may satisfy the coverage requirement; it may in every class.

## Points of reading (hypothetical)

- A Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan with a $3,000 coverage limit meets the minimum of the Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, Interior Standard, Climate Controlled and Climate Plus classes, but not the $5000 minimum of the Bluegate Premier Climate Suite.
- The highest minimum, $10000, belongs to the Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault.
